en: Are you sleeping? Are you sleeping?
Ring the matins; ring the matins;
Ding ding dong. Ding ding dong.
notes: line 1: 'Frère' is a friar or monk, 'Brother' as a title; Jacques is kept as a name (English versions of the round often call him John).
line 3: 'Sonnez les matines' is an imperative: ring (the bell for) matins, the night or early-morning prayer office. He has overslept his duty.
line 4: 'Din din don' is the sound of the bell, rendered with the English 'ding ding dong'.
